claims.statement: The dashboard server's default bind is 127.0.0.1:7333.
startDashboardServer refuses to start when the auth token is empty, on every bind including loopback.
The dashboard server refuses a foreign Host header or cross-origin Origin with 403 and requires a Bearer token on every /api/ path, returning 401 otherwise.
Every browser UI module must be listed in UI_MODULES, which builds the static file table the server serves.
The dashboard reaches the spine only by spawning the mc binary with the process environment passed through and parsing one JSON object from stdout.
verbResponse maps mc exit 0 to HTTP 200, domain rejections and usage errors to 400, record or operation conflicts to 409, and other failures to 500.
The pause routes call dedicated commands: GET /api/pause runs mc pause status, POST /api/pause runs mc pause, POST /api/resume runs mc resume, and per-Project routes run mc project pause or resume.
Pause all pauses every active Project in one transaction; Resume all resumes only paused Projects whose setup_status is ready, and pipeline agents cannot change a pause.
The wiki server listens by default on 127.0.0.1:7335 and answers only paths below the 64-hex wiki key, compared in constant time.
A wiki address that cannot start is logged as dash.wiki_failed and leaves the dashboard address running.
The attachment seam opens files with O_NOFOLLOW and serves only operator-owned regular files no larger than 64 MiB.
The host release closure test fails when the dashboard serves a file that the host release manifest does not ship.
The smoke harness shares one Chromium per Bun process and bootSmoke refuses to run without an absolute MC_SMOKE_BIN.
The shared dashboard stat helper places a value before its caption, and the value has larger, heavier type.
The Board shows blocked, active run, task, and stalled counts in order, then an expedited count when positive.
The Board stats use Blocked tasks and Stalled; Review uses Awaiting decision.
Board stats retain lead, zero, and blocked alert treatments; Review slots alert when capacity is exceeded.
The Review packet viewer shows a status, spinner, and placeholder lines while the report request is pending, and it hides the thesis during that state.
The Review decision controls remain disabled until the selected packet version's report loads.
The Setup Journal distinguishes complete reports from successful source acceptance and retains initial history.
The Setup Journal keeps one row per milestone at its first position and updates that row to the latest state.
A later setup attempt resets preparation to Started until its own result qualifies completion.
The Suggested setup card shows the Project image files and the setup script, and approval submits the displayed revision.
The setup journal smoke checks milestones through acceptance, history access from Environment, return to Environment, and the normal Board after reload.
The Pipeline role map distinguishes agent launch pending, current execution, and a stopped heartbeat.
The dashboard proxy obtains AgentsView credentials through the host command and keeps the token on the host.
The Project wiki section sits beside the task run banner above the task path and follows the banner at narrow widths.
Pipeline and Configs role details open in centered native modal dialogs.
The browser maps the Strategist identity to strategist(propose) for custom instructions.
Task role numbers use single digits and the shared Figtree font stack.
The current run card draws a pale egg outline behind content with pointer events disabled.
Before the first wiki state read, the Scribe section shows its schedule description.
The wiki state text reserves a minimum height of two lines.
Role dialogs attach to the document body and preserve focus across polls; child modals defer content replacement.
The Review quick chat stores drafts in memory per packet and restores the draft after a failed send.
The wide quick chat defaults to 400 pixels; its selected width hides the 200-pixel queue when the reader would have less than 640 pixels.
The visible quick chat refreshes every second for an owed reply and every ten seconds otherwise; a closed chat stops refresh requests.
The Review chat and the Homie page use the same packet conversation; archived Projects permit history display but refuse messages.
The Environment page reports Project home and disposable cache sizes separately and labels cache removal Clear /cache.
The task dialog shows the unsuccessful Verifier correction count and reserves the correction report for the correction limit alert.
Routine correction results use the neutral stone tone; blocked, infrastructure failure, and reaped outcomes retain the rust alert tone.
The role map smoke checks that correction history remains while the task dialog omits the correction problem.
The task path preserves task counts without correction details.
Role eggs use stage colors, a solid fill, and a thin outline; active cards use full color and a four-pixel halo.
The role egg repeats egg-rattle every 1.8 seconds only for running cards without starting or stale classes.
The global reduced-motion preference rule disables role egg animation.
A topology role is starting when all its active held runs await process start, and stale when any held run is stale.
Ask Homie creates an ordinary session and checks fresh history before another send after an uncertain response.
Diagnostic messages use an explicit field list and limit the summary to a labeled excerpt after 1,200 characters.
The diagnostic browser smoke checks task, connection, environment, setup, and run conversations.
The Arbiter card describes its purpose as choosing from proposed tasks.
The Pipeline Activity section follows the task path directly, while operator decisions and diagnostics use the persistent notice area.
The role map smoke checks centered dialogs and stable Activity positions at three widths in both themes.
Ask Homie opens the wide chat from the decision bar; the narrow layout hides that control and an empty decision bar.
The quick chat model control sets the Homie route and replaces an existing conversation when its selected profile differs.
A model change for a conversation with messages requires confirmation and retains the previous conversation in the session list.
Setup history appears in Environment when a setup identifier exists and initial setup completed or an environment revision is selected.
The Setup history action selects the Project and opens its journal on the Board, focuses its heading, and requests a refresh.
PacketList includes the task title in live and decided packet rows while retaining the thesis.
Review cards show the task title below metadata, limit it to three lines, and place merge or return details below it.
The packet row title supplies the reader and quick chat headings without a separate task read; chat can fall back to its conversation task title.
Unit and smoke tests cover packet title values, card placement, narrow Ledger containment, and view exclusion by task title.
Resolve decision for an operator decision report requires a changed description and a reason, and submits the Board revise action.
Homie panel headers use the shared blue panel color and white text.
A periodic page read clears errors only when the page scope and error counter remain unchanged.
The Board write callback preserves a task dialog closed during its refresh.
The Setup Journal places the current failure's Ask Homie action in the setup controls outside the transcript.
The dashboard-browser continuous integration job runs the complete browser suite through dashboard/smoke.sh.
Classed modal dialogs share a backdrop with opacity 0.46, including the role customization dialog.
The Score case dialog opens with showModal() before the control requests focus.
Closing the Score case dialog removes the dialog and retains its draft in memory.
The shared dialog frame keeps the header and footer outside the body's scroll region.
showDialog marks a newly opened dialog as stacked when another native modal exists; the marked backdrop uses opacity 0.16.
Trace access pages derive their light and dark palettes from the shipped dashboard stylesheet.
Trace access pages read their origin's theme selection and otherwise follow the system preference.
Project and agent profile renders preserve focus, selection direction, and body scroll position.
The convention smoke represents 200 percent desktop zoom with a 720 by 450 layout viewport.
The server and host release manifest include the shared components.js browser module.
The header places the theme button immediately before the lease badge in header-status and retains Wiki and Traces in the viewer links.
The header status group uses an 8-pixel flex gap and a flexible lease badge; the desktop header reserves calc(12rem + 40px) for it.
At 721 through 1024 pixels the header status group sits above the viewer links in the right grid column; narrower layouts retain the group in the wrapped header.
The theme button uses mountTheme, which stores mc.theme, falls back to the system preference, and updates the next-theme tooltip and dark-theme pressed state.
The theme unit tests check stored selection, system fallback, the initial page theme, and button state.
Role dialogs close through Close, Escape, or an outside click and return focus to the selected role.
The Configs role dialog smoke checks table position and focus return after Escape and Close.
Role eggs are hidden at viewport widths of 600 pixels or less.
The report document uses inline priority root and body styles for a light #fdfdfe sheet, navy text, and base typography.
The Review frame preserves report content and section order while Project instructions can change the default packet sections.
The divider stores the preferred Homie width in browser storage and limits its visible width to preserve a 400-pixel reader.
The Discord panel stores the opaque draft identity and navigation values in session storage, without the token or confirmation code.
The Discord API forwards allowed actions to host commands with JSON request bodies on standard input.
The agent connection panel offers sign-in through the supported host integration templates.
The browser excludes shared proposal task blocks from the issue count only with matching ownership and without a stall or allowance condition.
System status reports non-archived affected proposals and derives current block ownership from the recorded association, block kind, and reason.
Shared proposal detail views link to affected proposals, and the task dialog links to its shared decision.
The Review Task control reads the selected task before opening the shared task dialog.
The packet reader smoke checks task refresh, focus return, and narrow dialog input.
The reader bar omits queue age and the awaiting-decision tag while retaining decision time and the blocked task tag.
The task dialog shows run failure and correction allowances in its facts box with explanatory tooltips.
The task dialog places an origin mark below the first run, in the older runs list when one exists.
The Discord setup refresh control reloads servers and channels and keeps the selected channel when it remains available.
The Discord account step displays and copies the bare confirmation code.
The task dialog offers no Require decision control.
The task dialog omits Edit title and priority for packaged tasks.
The dashboard light theme defines porcelain paper, white body surfaces, navy text, and a subtle gray surface.
The dashboard uses theme-specific landscape images and palette colors for the egg and chick mark and favicon.
The logo button stores the background picture selection under mc.scene and applies a selection from another dashboard tab.
The dashboard shows theme-specific tile lines until the background picture is selected, then retains their position beneath the full picture.
The logo chick animates every 10 seconds and holds its moved position while the pointer is over the logo.
The Discord configuration lists thread permissions and explains that each channel message starts a new thread conversation.
The task dialog offers no Ask Homie action for an open Verifier correction alone.
A role dialog holds the latest content while a child modal is open and displays it when the child closes.
The Scribe smoke checks that a new Agent profile appears when the profile dialog closes and focus returns to the profile control.
The Files changed controls occupy the reader view row, while the file tree and diff begin below it.
The file tree column holds the file totals and comparison commits; state messages hold those commits when the file list is absent.
The browser stores the file tree visibility choice and retains it when a different packet opens.
The Files changed view loads both commit versions of an eligible text file only when the operator expands unmodified lines.
The dashboard reads the old and new file paths at the recorded comparison commits through the host-only repository file command.
The repository file command returns only UTF-8 regular files of at most 1 MiB at an exact commit and relative path.
A failed file version read clears the cached promise and displays the cause, so the next expansion retries.
The profile editor offers model effort levels, clears draft effort when the model or connection changes, and displays effort in profile and assignment views.
The profile editor labels model effort support and requires an available effort before a model test.
The role assignment dialog offers an Edit action for each enabled profile.
The smoke harness rejects a Discord socket path above 103 bytes before it creates the scratch home.
The dashboard-browser job sets MC_SMOKE_ROOT below the short RUNNER_TEMP/smoke path.
